text:
Mira: heading out in 10. this is the sunset shift handover — Jamal you're up as primary for the next 8h, Alex you're secondary unless anything changes. quick sanity sweep on permissions before I sign off:

Mira: PagerDuty
- Jamal: do you see the 'prod-critical' escalation policy and can you trigger a test page?

Jamal: i can see most policies but the escalation chain shows me only as 'Responder' not 'Escalation Target'. i can't trigger a full-page from the UI. anyone confirm?

Alex: i gave you the pd:eng-oncall-primary group on Tuesday. pd-bot should reflect that. try `pd whoami` or the ./tools/pd-check script.

pd-bot: @Jamal — pd-bot here. current PD groups for Jamal: [eng-oncall-responder]. No escalation role detected. Contact Ops Liaison for group grants or run the self-service request form: https://redwood.internal/pd-requests

Mira: ok — Ops Liaison, can you escalate Jamal to full primary rights? if not, Alex will need to be primary for first 30m while it's sorted.

Ops Liaison: copying the audit. I see Jamal has an outstanding grant request from last week that wasn't approved. I can approve now but need confirmation of MFA and SSO last-login.

Jamal: MFA is set (okta), last-login ~2h ago. please approve.

Ops Liaison: approved and added to pd:eng-oncall-primary. pd-bot should update in ~30s. Jamal, try `pd whoami` again.

Jamal: running `pd whoami` now — output shows: "name: Jamal, groups: eng-oncall-primary, eng-oncall-responder". Can trigger test page. sending small test to confirm :bell:

Mira: great. next — Grafana / dashboards & alerting playbooks:
- can you access the prod-kpis folder? link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ProdKpis
- do you have edit rights to silence alerts (grafana org role: Editor)?

Alex: Jamal currently has Viewer role on Grafana. Ops Liaison, can you bump to Editor for the shift window? we avoid making permanent role changes when possible, prefer timeboxed change (expires in 8h).

Ops Liaison: done — granted grafana:Editor until 2164586400 (8 hours). Jamal, you should be able to silence/annotate.

Jamal: confirmed I can silence and add annotations. see quick runbook note for silencing noisy alerts: `Runbook > Alerting > Grafana > Silences` (internal link)

Mira: AWS access check — you need assume-role into `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/eng-oncall` for most mitigation work. run `aws sts get-caller-identity` and then `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/eng-oncall --role-session-name oncall-session` to verify.

Jamal: ran `aws sts get-caller-identity` ok, then assume-role succeeded. i got temp creds and can access S3 logs and ecs describe-tasks.

Mira: perfect. final handover checklist (sunset shift credential sweep):
- PagerDuty primary role confirmed: yes (pd-bot shows eng-oncall-primary)
- Grafana Editor access timeboxed to shift: yes
- AWS assume-role works: yes
- Runbook links pinned in thread: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Oncall+Runbook#GrafanaSilences
- If any permission fails, escalate via Ops Liaisons or Slack DM to Alex for immediate takeover.

Jamal: i'm good. i'll monitor alerts and notify if anything spikes. leaving a short alert filter in Grafana for noisy deploy-job alerts.

Mira: thanks team. i'm signing off now — oncall-bot: i'm handing over to Jamal as primary.

incident-bot: [INFO] No active incidents in the last 30m. automated health checks OK.

Alex: ping me if anything odd. Jamal — good luck, reach out if you need immediate escalation. :thumbsup:

Jamal: thanks — will update if anything pops. heading into watch mode.
